name: Stanley Agriculture Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Stanley Agriculture Group Co.,Ltd. is a prominent Chinese enterprise specializing in the manufacturing and distribution of compound fertilizers throughout the country. Its diverse product portfolio includes a variety of fertilizer types such as sanan, phosphate, water-soluble, nitro, sulfur-based, and zinc power fertilizers, in addition to other related offerings. Established in 1992, the company is headquartered in Linyi, China. It adopted its current name, Stanley Agriculture Group Co.,Ltd., in July 2016, having previously operated as Stanley Fertilizer Co., Ltd.
